patterns.note: Property listings are presented in a responsive grid with consistent card dimensions and information hierarchy, organized into thematic sections.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif, while body text and secondary information use a lighter weight of the same family, often with uppercase for labels and navigation.
A high-contrast black and white palette is used for structural elements and text, allowing vibrant, full-bleed property photography to provide the primary visual interest and color.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect on scroll, while content sections below the fold fade in and slide up slightly as they enter the viewport.
Feature sections utilize a two-column main heading with a four-column grid for detailed benefits, creating a clear visual hierarchy and easy scannability.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that dynamically reduces in height and gains a solid white background color upon scrolling past the hero section, transitioning from transparent to opaque.
A subtle parallax effect is applied to the hero background image, creating a sense of depth and movement as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely using a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger or Locomotive Scroll for smooth, coordinated transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting text for labels and navigation items
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on cards and buttons, sharp corners elsewhere for a clean, modern look
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero section, balanced spacing in content grids and feature lists, creating a sense of spaciousness and luxury

standout: The design stands out through its sophisticated blend of high-quality, full-bleed photography and a minimalist, high-contrast interface. The subtle, well-executed scroll animations, particularly the sticky header transformation and content reveals, elevate the user experience, making the site feel premium and highly polished without being overly flashy.
